name: Crown Advanced Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Crown Advanced Material Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of composite film materials in China and internationally. The company offers BO backsheets, ISARD encapsulation film, actinia wire carrier film, Savimer protective film, PET structure aluminum laminated film, black film structure, aluminum laminated film, and nylon structure aluminum laminated film products, as well as photovoltaic module encapsulation materials, lithium battery soft package encapsulation materials, and special protective films. It also provides solutions for solar cell encapsulating material, PERC, TOPCon, HJT, and IBC cell encapsulation. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Yichun, China.
